summary: Approved sequence sheets for OD-18 powder (WA/2019/010) for Odraverne Pharmaceuticals: six-month humidity challenge pulls, the sealed and unsealed configurations compared, and the agreed actions. Moisture uptake explained the assay drift, and Odraverne specified desiccant protection for the next pack configuration.

properties.title: OD18 pulls and humidity results Rev03

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: Odraverne OD-18 powder: six-month humidity challenge

rows: Six-month stability of OD-18 powder under humidity challenge at 25 °C/60% RH and 40 °C/75% RH. Pulls at 0, 3 and 6 months; the three-month interim review was completed on 13 May 2019.

Assay at time zero was {{PRJ0092:stability.t0_assay}} % label claim. The assay drift seen at the warm condition followed moisture uptake, not chemical instability. Odraverne specified desiccant protection for the next pack configuration.
Stability results and total impurities chart

sheets.name: Pulls
rows: Assay as % label claim (HPLC). Impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer. Pulls from the ICH chamber programme as recorded on the batch card.

sheets.name: Humidity
rows: Powder held in open dish and in the two sealed configurations below, at both conditions. Sealed samples were opened only at the pull.
Proposed for the next pack configuration
Chamber logs were reviewed at each pull. No alarm affected the warm condition during the study.

sheets.name: Actions
rows: Specify desiccant canister in the next pack configuration
Add moisture-uptake check at the three-month pull for future humidity programmes
Re-run assay on retained samples from the six-month pull after the moisture check
